dialogues.speaker: 일본 참모 (부하2)
dialogues.text: 敵艦十隻、発見との報告です！
dialogues.meaning: 적의 군함 열 척이 발견됐다는 보고입니다!

dialogues.speaker: 나구모
dialogues.text: 何だと？……いきなり、どこから現れた？

dialogues.speaker: 나구모
dialogues.text: ミッドウェー攻撃隊を、魚雷と徹甲爆弾に再換装せよ！敵艦隊を撃滅する！
dialogues.meaning: 미드웨이로 가려던 공격대를 어뢰와 철갑폭탄으로 재무장하라! 적 함대를 궤멸시킨다!

dialogues.speaker: 일본 참모 (부하2)
dialogues.text: 換装中に攻撃されたら……。

style_lock:
[STYLE LOCK]
Photoreal live-action WWII epic, Battle of Midway, June 4 1942. Large-format cinema camera, spherical primes, fine film grain, soft highlight roll-off, deep atmospheric haze at distance.
Palette: steel-teal sea, milky high-key sky with towering cumulus, white coral sand, olive-drab, khaki and dark navy, warm tanned skin. Orange fire only at the instant of an explosion or a burning wing; flak is black, smoke charcoal, sea spray white. No oversaturated cyan, no game sheen.
Every frame in three layers: dark foreground occluder (sandbag, barrel, window frame, wing edge, hull rail) — subject — vast sky, sea or battle beyond. Exteriors: men small against the sky. Interiors: hard window light, haze, and the battle outside always visible or audible.
Real-time speed, no slow motion. 16:9, 1080p. Light, haze, smoke and wind stay continuous across cuts.

cast_bible.label: 미군 레이더병
cast_bible.prompt_en: RADAR OPERATOR — American, 22. Narrow face, pale indoor skin with faint acne scars on the cheeks, light-brown side-parted short hair, round steel-rimmed glasses, thin lips, prominent Adam's apple. Khaki shirt, sleeves rolled.
cast_bible.ko: 22세. 좁고 긴 얼굴, 창백한 피부·볼의 옅은 여드름 자국, 옆가르마 갈색 단발, 둥근 철테 안경, 얇은 입술, 도드라진 목젖. 카키 셔츠.

cast_bible.label: 미군 관측병
cast_bible.prompt_en: OBSERVER — American Marine, 28. Square angular jaw, heavy straight dark eyebrows, grey-blue eyes, nose slightly crooked from an old break, clean-shaven, sunburnt red neck, dark-brown hair under an M1917 steel helmet.
cast_bible.ko: 28세. 각진 사각 턱, 굵은 일자 눈썹, 회청색 눈, 살짝 휜 콧등, 면도, 붉게 탄 목, 철모 아래 짙은 갈색 머리.

cast_bible.label: 미군 전화병
cast_bible.prompt_en: PHONE TALKER — American Marine, 19. Boyish round face, dense freckles, strawberry-blond hair, light eyelashes, headset over his helmet.
cast_bible.ko: 19세. 앳된 둥근 얼굴, 짙은 주근깨, 붉은 기 금발, 옅은 속눈썹, 철모 위 헤드셋.

cast_bible.label: 1번 포 포반장
cast_bible.prompt_en: GUN CAPTAIN — Marine gunnery sergeant, 36. Broad weathered face, deep crow's-feet, neat short dark-brown mustache, cleft chin, cigarette at the corner of his mouth, faded anchor tattoo on the right forearm.
cast_bible.ko: 36세 상사. 넓고 풍파 맞은 얼굴, 깊은 눈가 주름, 단정한 짧은 갈색 콧수염, 갈라진 턱, 입가 담배, 오른팔 바랜 닻 문신.

cast_bible.label: 1번 포 포수
cast_bible.prompt_en: GUN POINTER — Marine, 24, Italian-American. Short-cropped black curly hair, thick black eyebrows, aquiline nose, olive skin, three-day black stubble.
cast_bible.ko: 24세 이탈리아계. 짧은 검은 곱슬머리, 굵은 눈썹, 매부리코, 올리브빛 피부, 사흘 수염.

cast_bible.label: 1번 포 장전수
cast_bible.prompt_en: LOADER — Marine, 20. Big broad frame, blond buzz cut, wide flat face, pink sunburn across nose and cheeks, sweat-soaked undershirt under an open utility jacket.
cast_bible.ko: 20세. 큰 체격, 금발 버즈컷, 넓고 평평한 얼굴, 코·볼 분홍 화상, 땀 젖은 러닝셔츠.

cast_bible.label: 미드웨이 정비 반장
cast_bible.prompt_en: GROUND CREW CHIEF — American, 40. Bald under a soft cap, grey stubble, heavy jowls, grease on his cheek, stained coveralls.
cast_bible.ko: 40세. 작업모 아래 대머리, 회색 수염 자국, 처진 턱살, 볼의 기름, 얼룩진 작업복.

cast_bible.label: B-26 조종사
cast_bible.prompt_en: B-26 PILOT — American Army pilot, 30. Long lean face, thin pencil mustache, hazel eyes, fair skin, brown hair under a leather flight helmet, goggles up, sweat at the temples.
cast_bible.ko: 30세. 길고 마른 얼굴, 가는 연필 콧수염, 담갈색 눈, 흰 피부, 가죽 비행모·이마의 고글.

cast_bible.label: B-26 부조종사
cast_bible.prompt_en: B-26 CO-PILOT — American, 25. Round face, black hair, thick joined eyebrows, dark-brown eyes, soft rounded chin, headset over his flight helmet.
cast_bible.ko: 25세. 둥근 얼굴, 검은 머리, 붙은 듯 굵은 눈썹, 짙은 갈색 눈, 부드러운 턱.

cast_bible.label: 미 항모 비행갑판 장교
cast_bible.prompt_en: FLIGHT DECK OFFICER — American Navy, 34. Lean leathery face, squinting pale eyes, sharp nose, yellow jersey and cloth helmet, a chequered flag in his right hand.
cast_bible.ko: 34세. 마르고 가죽 같은 얼굴, 가늘게 뜬 옅은 눈, 날카로운 코, 노란 상의·천 헬멧, 오른손 체크 깃발.

cast_bible.label: TBD 조종사 A
cast_bible.prompt_en: TBD PILOT A — American Navy, 26. Square face, sandy-blond hair, blue eyes, strong square chin, clean-shaven, khaki flight suit, yellow life vest.
cast_bible.ko: 26세. 사각 얼굴, 모래빛 금발, 파란 눈, 각진 턱, 면도, 카키 비행복·노란 구명조끼.

cast_bible.label: TBD 조종사 B
cast_bible.prompt_en: TBD PILOT B — American Navy, 23. Long narrow face, dark-brown wavy hair, hooded brown eyes, long straight nose, olive tan, khaki flight suit, yellow life vest.
cast_bible.ko: 23세. 좁고 긴 얼굴, 짙은 갈색 웨이브, 처진 갈색 눈, 긴 콧대, 올리브 태닝.

cast_bible.label: TBD B 후방 사수
cast_bible.prompt_en: REAR GUNNER — American Navy, 19. Skinny, prominent ears, short mousy-brown hair, boyish chin, sunburnt nose, goggles on his helmet.
cast_bible.ko: 19세. 마른 체격, 튀어나온 귀, 짧은 쥐색 갈색 머리, 앳된 턱, 탄 코.

cast_bible.label: 일본 공격대 편대장
cast_bible.prompt_en: JAPANESE STRIKE LEADER — Japanese naval aviator, 32. Lean hard face, high cheekbones, narrow monolid eyes with a steady unblinking stare, straight low nose bridge, thin firm lips, dark sun-weathered skin, brown leather flight helmet, goggles, white silk scarf. Never smiles.
cast_bible.ko: 32세. 마르고 단단한 얼굴, 높은 광대, 흔들림 없는 홑꺼풀 눈, 낮고 곧은 콧대, 얇은 입술, 짙게 그을린 피부, 흰 머플러. 웃지 않는다.

cast_bible.label: 제로센 조종사
cast_bible.prompt_en: ZERO PILOT — Japanese naval aviator, 24. Rounder face, thick straight eyebrows, single-lid eyes, small pale scar on the left side of the chin, clean-shaven, leather helmet and goggles.
cast_bible.ko: 24세. 둥근 얼굴, 굵은 일자 눈썹, 홑꺼풀, 왼쪽 턱의 작은 흰 흉터, 면도.

cast_bible.label: 아카기 견시원
cast_bible.prompt_en: AKAGI LOOKOUT — Japanese petty officer, 30. Square weathered face, deep vertical frown line between the brows, near-shaved head under a white cap cover, chin strap, large pedestal binoculars.
cast_bible.ko: 30세. 사각의 그을린 얼굴, 미간의 깊은 세로 주름, 흰 모자 덮개 아래 삭발, 턱끈, 대형 거치 쌍안경.

cast_bible.label: 일본 대공포 사수
cast_bible.prompt_en: JAPANESE AA GUNNER — Japanese sailor, 21. Thin face, sharp jaw, shaved head under a steel helmet with chin strap, gritted teeth, white undershirt, sweat; sits in the pointer seat of a twin 25mm mount.
cast_bible.ko: 21세. 마른 얼굴, 날카로운 턱, 철모 아래 삭발, 악문 이, 흰 러닝셔츠. 연장 기관포 조준석.

cast_bible.label: 일본 대공포 급탄수
cast_bible.prompt_en: JAPANESE AA LOADER — Japanese sailor, 19. Round boyish face, near-shaved head, wide-set eyes, flushed cheeks, white towel around his neck, slams 15-round box magazines onto the gun.
cast_bible.ko: 19세. 둥근 앳된 얼굴, 짧은 삭발, 넓은 미간, 상기된 볼, 목의 흰 수건. 15발 상자 탄창 장전.

cast_bible.label: 나구모
cast_bible.prompt_en: NAGUMO — Japanese vice admiral, 55 (approved reference image governs). Broad heavy face, deep nasolabial folds, heavy-lidded drooping eyes, short grey toothbrush mustache, grey close-cropped sideburns. Peaked naval cap in EVERY shot. Dark navy uniform, white gloves.
cast_bible.ko: 55세. 승인본 에셋 최우선. 넓고 무거운 얼굴, 깊은 팔자주름, 처진 눈, 짧은 회색 칫솔 콧수염. 모든 샷 군모, 흰 장갑.

cast_bible.label: 일본 함교 참모 (대본의 부하2)
cast_bible.prompt_en: STAFF OFFICER — Japanese officer, 42. Slim oval face, narrow chin, thin metal-rimmed rectangular glasses, clean-shaven, neat hair under his cap, composed but tight mouth, clipboard of message forms.
cast_bible.ko: 42세. 갸름한 계란형, 좁은 턱, 가는 금속테 사각 안경, 면도, 굳게 다문 입, 전문 용지 클립보드.

cast_bible.label: 일본 통신병
cast_bible.prompt_en: SIGNALMAN — Japanese sailor, 22. Thin boyish face, round cheeks, near-shaved head, headset clamped over a cloth cap, pencil behind his ear.
cast_bible.ko: 22세. 마른 앳된 얼굴, 둥근 볼, 삭발, 천 모자 위 헤드셋, 귀에 꽂은 연필.

cast_bible.label: 격납고 무장 반장
cast_bible.prompt_en: ORDNANCE CHIEF — Japanese petty officer, 35. Broad flat face, shaved head glistening with sweat, thick neck, towel twisted into a headband, loud whistle on a cord.
cast_bible.ko: 35세. 넓고 평평한 얼굴, 땀 맺힌 삭발, 굵은 목, 머리띠처럼 감은 수건, 목에 건 호루라기.

cast_bible.label: 격납고 무장 작업원들
cast_bible.prompt_en: ORDNANCE CREW — Japanese sailors, 18–25, shaved heads, white or grey work clothes darkened by sweat, cotton gloves, hachimaki or towels; every face different.
cast_bible.ko: 18–25세 수병들. 삭발, 땀에 젖은 흰·회색 작업복, 면장갑, 머리띠·수건. 같은 얼굴 반복 금지.

cast_rules.US: Americans: varied European-American ancestry (Irish, Italian, German, Polish), varied hair colour, deeper-set eyes, higher nose bridges, forearm hair, sunburnt red-pink skin, stubble, sweat. Real 1942 faces — no movie-star polish.
cast_rules.JP: Japanese: authentic adult Japanese men of 1942 — lean, wiry, compact builds; enlisted heads shaved or near-shaved, officers short-cropped; monolid or hooded eyes, straight lower nose bridge, defined cheekbones, bronze tan, clean-shaven unless stated. Natural, dignified — never caricature, never modern idol styling.
